_comment: Z1-pool words of the root whose target is linked by NO phase of this build.
#ZDCDDS4 and #ZDKFCM5 point at #CDCDDS4 and #CDKFCM5, which only the SM4 deck
(phase 16) INSERTs; OI340700 excludes SM OPS 4 (zero-byte CS4DART, CS4IFT, CS4INI,
CS4PAR, CS4PAT, SM4OPS), so phase 16 is not linked and the words cannot be
resolved.  The values are the flight image's (mafgen/SSW.fcm), where they equal
#ZDCDDS2 and #ZDKFCM4: SM4 lays out those procedures where SM2 does.  Only SM OPS
4 reaches them.  Written into PHASE02.lib by link-and-cut.sh stage 4c, which
refuses a word that does not hold the unresolved stub 8000 0E00.
